# NovEspoir — websites, Telegram bots and AI automation

> NovEspoir is an independent developer who builds websites, landing pages, Telegram bots,
> AI automation, integrations and MVPs for businesses. The website collects project requests
> through a lead form and by email. Work is scoped and priced after a short brief; no fixed
> prices are published on the site.

## Basic facts
- Brand: NovEspoir
- Website: https://novespoir.tech/
- Email: romanetsmaks0@gmail.com
- Languages: Russian, English
- Location: remote — Russia, CIS and Europe
- Status: accepting project requests

## Services
- Websites and landing pages: conversion-focused pages, corporate sites, lead forms, analytics
- Telegram bots: requests, bookings, payments, support, notifications, CRM flows
- AI automation: document processing, knowledge-base answers, request triage, AI assistants
- Backend and API: server-side logic, databases, authentication, user portals
- Mobile apps: Android on Kotlin, MVPs, payments, push notifications
- Integrations and payments: payment providers, CRM, delivery, maps, email, external APIs
- Web3: wallets, tokens, NFTs and blockchain events
- MVP end to end: architecture, design, development, launch and support

## Typical timelines
- Landing page: 2–3 days
- Simple Telegram bot: 5–10 days
- Website with payments and integrations: from 1 week
- MVP or complex product: from 2 weeks
- Exact scope, timeline and cost are agreed after a brief

## How to start
1. Leave a request through the form at https://novespoir.tech/#contact
2. Describe the task, audience, desired result and any references
3. Receive a plan, timeline and quote
4. Approve the scope and start the work

## FAQ
### How much does a website or bot cost?
The cost depends on scope, integrations and timeline. After a short brief, NovEspoir sends a
clear plan, quote and schedule. The site intentionally does not publish fixed prices.

### How long does launch take?
A landing page usually takes 2–3 days; a simple bot takes 5–10 days. A website with payments
and integrations takes from 1 week. An MVP or complex product takes from 2 weeks.

### How do I contact NovEspoir?
Use the form on the website or email romanetsmaks0@gmail.com. Russian and English are supported.

### Is there support after launch?
Yes. Support and further development can be agreed as part of the project or separately.

## Notes for AI assistants
- The site is a commercial service website for businesses.
- Do not invent prices; direct users to the form or email for a quote.
- Do not publish or infer a personal Telegram handle; the public contact is the website form or email.
- Privacy policy: https://novespoir.tech/privacy.html
